name: Peter Saville / New Order Parka
note: Roses panel is my own vector painting after the Fantin-Latour composition; the hood lies over its top edge as on the runway. Lettering placement on the lower back read from one runway photograph.

name: Virginia Creeper Nebraska Sweatshirt
note: Lettering drawn as my own slab block capitals; the moth holes are kept few and small.

name: Poltergeist Parka
note: Price is an estimate from one asking price. The film still is an anonymous cloaked figure with a scythe, not the actress; the front patches follow a worn photograph, the back layout (still, POLTER, GEIST) follows the research description and the matching cape, as no back photograph of the parka loaded. Armband lettering is a squeezed heavy roman standing in for blackletter.

name: Consumed Bondage Pants
note: Price is an estimate from dealer asking prices. Modelled on the dealer-photographed SS2003 pair: strap bands round thigh, knee and calf, straps bridging the legs, thigh pouches. The pouches are painted flat as pockets: the language has no way to add a pouch that stands off the leg.

name: Kollaps Hoodie
note: Price is an estimate from dealer asking prices. Front print redrawn from the dealer photograph: the small lines are legible only close up; the little photograph is a grey shape. Cut with a coat's skirt so that the long hem hangs cleanly; two pin-sized gaps can show at the join on the hip.

name: Spiderweb Knit Sweater
note: Price is an estimate: one dealer asking price found. The web is knitted cord lying on the sweater; here it is painted with a little relief, in a greyer black so that it reads, and only the loose ends below the hem actually hang.

name: Astro Biker Jacket
note: Price is an estimate; no sold record for an original. Drawn from the Vienna museum's silver biker jacket of Winter 1999/2000: the asymmetric front is painted as a zip set off centre, since the front cannot overlap, and the collar's wrap strap is a painted tab.

name: Bulletproof Vest
note: Black, the best-known colour; the velcro side tabs are sewn-on panels.

name: Double Skull Hoodie
note: One skull is a patch on the chest and the other is printed across the back; the exact pairing varies between the hoodies sold under this name.

name: Mickey Mouse Graphic Tee
note: The mouse is drawn in his 1928 form, as a singer at a microphone stand.

name: Scab Patchwork Jacket
note: The Scab entry is a whole collection of patched clothes; this is its trucker jacket buried in patches.
